About our brand and products:
Sync Beauty is a modern beauty brand created for effortless, elevated everyday routines. Our products are designed to enhance natural beauty with high-performance formulas, beautiful textures, and easy-to-use essentials for lips, brows, and skin. We create beauty products that feel premium, look beautiful, and fit naturally into a modern lifestyle.

What makes us different:
Sync Beauty combines aesthetic, high-quality beauty products with a strong lifestyle identity. Our brand is built around confidence, femininity, self-expression, and effortless beauty. We are makeup products with skincare benefits

How affiliates can earn:
Approved affiliates receive a unique affiliate link and/or personal discount code to share with their audience. When someone makes a qualifying purchase through your link or code, you earn commission on the sale. Commission is tracked through our affiliate platform, and eligible payouts are made according to our program terms.

How to promote us:
Affiliates can promote Sync Beauty through Instagram, TikTok, YouTube. You can share product reviews, tutorials, GRWM videos, beauty routines, before-and-after content, favourites, gift guides, product recommendations, and lifestyle content featuring Sync Beauty products. All promotional content must clearly disclose the affiliate relationship, for example by using “Ad”, “Affiliate link”, or “I earn commission from purchases made through my link/code.”

Other information:
We are looking for creators, influencers, beauty lovers, and brand ambassadors who genuinely connect with Sync Beauty and want to share our products authentically with their audience. Approved affiliates may receive access to brand materials, campaign updates, product information, exclusive offers, and future collaboration opportunities. Participation is subject to approval and compliance with Sync Beauty’s Affiliate Program Terms and Conditions.

SYNC BEAUTY AFFILIATE & AMBASSADOR PROGRAM TERMS AND CONDITIONS

Last updated: 25.06.2026

These Affiliate & Ambassador Program Terms and Conditions (“Terms”) govern participation in the Sync Beauty Affiliate and Ambassador Program (“Program”).

The Program is operated by MNKY GROUP LTD, a company registered in Cyprus (“Company”, “Sync Beauty”, “we”, “us”, or “our”).

By applying to, joining, or participating in the Program, you (“Affiliate”, “Ambassador”, “Creator”, “you”, or “your”) agree to be legally bound by these Terms.

If you do not agree to these Terms, you must not apply to or participate in the Program.

1. Company Information

Brand: Sync Beauty
Company: MNKY GROUP LTD
Registered jurisdiction: Cyprus
Registered address: 155 Arch. Makariou, 3026, Limassol, Cyprus
Contact email: hello@syncbeauty.com
Website: syncbeauty.com

2. Program Overview

The Program allows approved creators, influencers, publishers, affiliates, and ambassadors to promote Sync Beauty products through approved referral links, discount codes, content, social media posts, email, websites, and other approved marketing channels.

Approved Affiliates may earn commission on eligible sales generated through their unique affiliate link or code, subject to these Terms.

Participation in the Program does not create an employment relationship, partnership, joint venture, franchise, agency, or legal representative relationship between you and Sync Beauty.

3. Eligibility

To apply for and participate in the Program, you must:

  1. be at least 18 years old;

  2. have full legal capacity to enter into a binding agreement;

  3. provide accurate, complete, and truthful information;

  4. own or lawfully control the social media accounts, websites, channels, email lists, or other platforms used to promote Sync Beauty;

  5. comply with all applicable laws, advertising standards, platform rules, and consumer protection regulations;

  6. not engage in fraudulent, misleading, deceptive, offensive, or unlawful conduct;

  7. not be located in a jurisdiction where participation in the Program would be unlawful.

Sync Beauty may approve, reject, suspend, or terminate any application or account at its sole discretion.

Submitting an application does not guarantee acceptance into the Program.

4. Application Process

To apply, you may be asked to provide:

  1. full name;

  2. email address;

  3. phone number;

  4. country of residence;

  5. shipping address;

  6. social media handles;

  7. website or blog URL;

  8. audience demographics;

  9. engagement statistics;

  10. content examples;

  11. payment information;

  12. tax information;

  13. any other information reasonably required to assess your application.

You represent and warrant that all information submitted is accurate, current, and not misleading.

Sync Beauty may request additional information before approving or continuing your participation.

5. Approval and Account Access

If approved, you may receive access to an affiliate dashboard, referral link, discount code, campaign materials, brand assets, product information, and performance tracking tools.

You are responsible for keeping your login details confidential.

You must not share your affiliate account, referral link access, dashboard access, payment account, or confidential campaign information with any third party without written permission.

You are responsible for all activity under your account.

6. Affiliate Responsibilities

You agree to:

  1. promote Sync Beauty honestly and professionally;

  2. comply with these Terms and all brand guidelines provided by Sync Beauty;

  3. comply with all applicable advertising, consumer protection, privacy, data protection, intellectual property, and platform rules;

  4. clearly disclose your commercial relationship with Sync Beauty;

  5. ensure that all claims about Sync Beauty products are truthful, accurate, substantiated, and not misleading;

  6. avoid making medical, therapeutic, clinical, or guaranteed-result claims;

  7. avoid suggesting that Sync Beauty products diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease or medical condition;

  8. avoid using fake followers, bots, engagement pods, click farms, misleading traffic, or fraudulent orders;

  9. avoid damaging the reputation, goodwill, or public image of Sync Beauty;

  10. promptly remove or correct any content if requested by Sync Beauty.

7. Advertising Disclosure Requirements

You must clearly and prominently disclose your relationship with Sync Beauty in every post, story, reel, video, livestream, blog post, email, podcast, website page, or other content where you promote Sync Beauty and may receive commission, payment, free product, gifted product, discount, or any other benefit.

Disclosure must be:

  1. clear;

  2. easy to notice;

  3. placed before or at the beginning of the promotional content;

  4. understandable to the average consumer;

  5. repeated where necessary, including in each story slide, video, caption, description, or link placement;

  6. not hidden among hashtags or at the end of a long caption.

Acceptable disclosures may include:

“Ad”
“Advertisement”
“Paid partnership with Sync Beauty”
“I earn commission from purchases made through my link/code”
“Affiliate link”
“Gifted by Sync Beauty”
“PR product received from Sync Beauty”

Where required, you must use platform tools such as “Paid Partnership” labels.

You must not use unclear disclosures such as:

“sp”
“spon”
“thanks”
“collab” without additional context
“ambassador” without explaining the commercial relationship

You are solely responsible for ensuring that your disclosures comply with applicable laws and platform rules in your country and in the countries where your audience is located.

8. Product Claims and Content Accuracy

You must not make false, exaggerated, misleading, or unapproved claims about Sync Beauty products.

Unless expressly approved in writing by Sync Beauty, you must not claim that Sync Beauty products:

  1. cure acne;

  2. treat eczema;

  3. treat rosacea;

  4. treat dermatitis;

  5. provide medical results;

  6. permanently change skin, lips, brows, or hair;

  7. are clinically proven, dermatologist-approved, hypoallergenic, non-comedogenic, organic, natural, vegan, cruelty-free, or sustainable unless this is officially confirmed by Sync Beauty;

  8. guarantee specific results;

  9. are suitable for every person;

  10. are free from all allergens or irritants.

You may share your honest personal experience, provided it is truthful, not misleading, and clearly presented as your own experience.

You must not present personal results as typical or guaranteed.

9. Brand Guidelines

You must follow all Sync Beauty brand guidelines provided to you.

Unless approved in writing, you must not:

  1. alter Sync Beauty logos;

  2. modify official product images in a misleading way;

  3. use Sync Beauty trademarks in your own business name, username, domain name, email address, app name, or social media handle;

  4. create websites or pages that look like official Sync Beauty websites;

  5. imply that you are employed by Sync Beauty;

  6. imply that you are an official representative of Sync Beauty;

  7. speak on behalf of Sync Beauty;

  8. register any domain, trademark, company name, or social account containing “Sync Beauty” or similar terms;

  9. use Sync Beauty brand assets in a way that is offensive, misleading, low-quality, or inconsistent with the brand image.

10. Approved Marketing Channels

You may promote Sync Beauty through approved channels, including:

  1. Instagram;

  2. TikTok;

  3. YouTube;

  4. Pinterest;

  5. blogs;

  6. websites;

  7. newsletters;

  8. approved paid campaigns;

  9. other channels approved by Sync Beauty.

Sync Beauty may restrict or prohibit any promotional channel at any time.

11. Prohibited Activities

You must not:

  1. generate fake clicks, leads, orders, or traffic;

  2. use bots, scripts, automation, click farms, or artificial engagement;

  3. place affiliate links in spam emails, spam comments, spam messages, or unsolicited communications;

  4. engage in cookie stuffing, forced clicks, hidden links, pop-ups, redirects, or misleading tracking methods;

  5. use your own affiliate link or discount code for self-purchases unless expressly permitted;

  6. encourage others to return products after commission is earned;

  7. bid on Sync Beauty trademarks, brand terms, misspellings, or competitor terms in paid search without written permission;

  8. run Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, Pinterest Ads, or other paid ads using Sync Beauty brand names without written permission;

  9. use misleading discount, coupon, cashback, or deal websites;

  10. list unauthorized discount codes;

  11. impersonate Sync Beauty;

  12. copy Sync Beauty’s website, landing pages, product descriptions, or creative assets without permission;

  13. promote Sync Beauty on websites or accounts containing hate speech, harassment, pornography, illegal content, violence, discrimination, political extremism, or content damaging to the brand;

  14. make medical, therapeutic, or unlawful claims;

  15. misrepresent your audience, statistics, engagement, identity, location, or promotional methods;

  16. violate any platform terms;

  17. infringe third-party intellectual property rights;

  18. engage in any conduct that may harm Sync Beauty’s reputation.

12. Referral Links, Codes and Tracking

Approved Affiliates may receive a unique affiliate link or discount code.

Sales are tracked through the affiliate platform used by Sync Beauty.

A sale may be eligible for commission only if:

  1. the customer uses your approved affiliate link or code;

  2. the sale is properly tracked by the affiliate platform;

  3. the order is successfully paid;

  4. the order is not cancelled, refunded, returned, disputed, fraudulent, or charged back;

  5. the sale complies with these Terms.

Sync Beauty is not responsible for tracking failures caused by:

  1. deleted cookies;

  2. browser settings;

  3. ad blockers;

  4. private browsing;

  5. incorrect links;

  6. platform downtime;

  7. customer error;

  8. technical limitations;

  9. attribution conflicts;

  10. use of multiple affiliate links or codes.

Unless otherwise stated, Sync Beauty may use last-click attribution.

Cookie duration: 30 DAYS

13. Commission

Commission rate: 10% OF NET SALES

Commission is calculated on eligible net sales, excluding:

  1. VAT;

  2. sales tax;

  3. shipping;

  4. duties;

  5. refunds;

  6. discounts;

  7. chargebacks;

  8. returned items;

  9. cancelled orders;

  10. fraudulent orders;

  11. gift cards;

  12. taxes;

  13. payment processing fees;

  14. any other excluded amounts determined by Sync Beauty.

Sync Beauty may change commission rates, campaign rules, payout thresholds, cookie duration, or attribution rules at any time.

Commission is not guaranteed.

14. Payment

Payments will be made through the affiliate platform or another payment method approved by Sync Beauty.

Payment method: [PayPal / Wise / Bank Transfer / Affiliate App Payment System]

Minimum payout threshold: £20

Payment schedule: within 30 days after the end of each calendar month

Sync Beauty may withhold payment if:

  1. payment details are incomplete or incorrect;

  2. tax information is missing;

  3. fraud is suspected;

  4. orders are under review;

  5. refund periods have not expired;

  6. the Affiliate has breached these Terms;

  7. required compliance checks are incomplete.

You are responsible for any bank fees, currency conversion charges, payment provider fees, and taxes.

15. Refunds, Returns and Chargebacks

If a customer order is refunded, returned, cancelled, disputed, or charged back, any related commission may be reversed, cancelled, deducted from future payments, or reclaimed.

Sync Beauty’s tracking and order records are final unless there is a clear technical error.

16. Taxes

You are solely responsible for all taxes, filings, registrations, declarations, social security contributions, VAT, income tax, and other obligations arising from your participation in the Program.

Sync Beauty does not provide tax advice.

You must provide accurate tax documentation if requested.

17. Free Products, Gifts and PR Packages

Sync Beauty may, at its discretion, provide free products, gifts, PR packages, samples, discount codes, or other benefits.

Receipt of free products does not guarantee continued participation, payment, commission, or future collaboration.

Any gifted products must be disclosed clearly in accordance with applicable advertising laws.

Unless otherwise agreed in writing, Sync Beauty is not obligated to send products, pay for content, reimburse expenses, or provide ongoing benefits.

18. Content Creation

You are responsible for creating content that is:

  1. original;

  2. lawful;

  3. truthful;

  4. high-quality;

  5. compliant with advertising laws;

  6. compliant with platform rules;

  7. respectful of third-party rights;

  8. consistent with Sync Beauty’s brand image.

You must obtain all permissions, licenses, and releases required for any people, music, images, video, locations, brands, or third-party content included in your content.

19. Content Usage Rights

By tagging Sync Beauty, submitting content to Sync Beauty, uploading content to the affiliate platform, participating in the Program, or creating content featuring Sync Beauty products, you grant Sync Beauty a worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid, non-exclusive, transferable, sublicensable licence to use, repost, share, reproduce, edit, adapt, crop, resize, translate, distribute, display, publish, and otherwise use the content for organic marketing purposes, including:

  4. press materials;

  5. retailer presentations;

  6. affiliate program materials;

  7. internal brand materials.

Paid advertising usage is not included unless separately agreed in writing.

If Sync Beauty wishes to use your content in paid ads, whitelisting, dark posts, paid social, paid search, paid display, marketplace ads, retailer ads, or other paid media, the parties should agree separate written terms.

You confirm that you own or control all rights required to grant this licence.

You receive a limited, revocable, non-exclusive, non-transferable licence to use approved brand materials solely for the purpose of promoting Sync Beauty under these Terms.

You must stop using Sync Beauty intellectual property immediately upon termination or request.

21. Confidentiality

  1. commission rates;

  2. campaign terms;

  3. launch plans;

  4. product information;

  5. unreleased products;

  8. customer information;

You must not disclose confidential information without written permission.

Sync Beauty may monitor your content, links, traffic, sales, disclosures, and promotional methods to ensure compliance.

You agree to provide reasonable information if Sync Beauty investigates suspected fraud, non-compliance, or misleading promotion.

Sync Beauty may request that you edit, correct, archive, or delete content.

You must comply promptly.

  1. breach these Terms;

  2. violate advertising laws;

  3. fail to disclose your relationship with Sync Beauty;

  4. make misleading claims;

  5. engage in fraud;
